items.markingKey: False (½ mark); correction: 'community' in place of 'judge' (½ mark). Majority rule in a democracy does not mean rule by the majority community in terms of religion, race or language.

items.stem:
Match Column A with Column B and choose the correct option.
Column A:
1. Accountable government
2. Economic growth
3. Dictatorship
4. Right to Information
Column B:

items.stem: State whether the statement is True or False. If false, correct it: Democracies are based on political inequality, giving every citizen equal weight in electing representatives.
items.answer: False. Democracies are based on political equality, giving every citizen equal weight in electing representatives.
items.markingKey: False (½ mark); correction: 'equality' in place of 'inequality' (½ mark). Democracies are based on political equality, giving every citizen equal weight in electing representatives.

items.stem:
Read the revision note prepared by a Class 10 student on "Accountable, responsive and legitimate government" and answer the questions that follow.
"Democratic government may be slower, but its decisions are more (A) ______ to the people. A citizen's right to examine the process of decision-making is called (B) ______."
(i) Fill in blank (A). (1 mark)
(ii) Fill in blank (B). (1 mark)
(iii) Why is a democratic government called a legitimate government? (2 marks)
items.answer: (i) acceptable (ii) transparency (iii) (1) It is elected by the people. (2) People accept it as their own government.
items.markingKey: (i) acceptable – 1 mark. (ii) transparency – 1 mark. (iii) any two points, 1 mark each: (1) It is elected by the people. (2) People accept it as their own government.

items.stem: What is meant by 'economic inequality'?
items.answer: The unequal distribution of income and wealth among people.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for the idea: the unequal distribution of income and wealth among people.

items.stem: Choose the correct option to complete the statement: Democracy stands much superior to any other form of government in promoting the ______ and freedom of the individual.
items.answer: dignity
items.markingKey: (b) Democracy stands much superior to any other form of government in promoting the dignity and freedom of the individual.
